purpose: Estimate remaining sealed fraction only when quantitative evidence supports it.
rules: Qualitative sold-out signals do not equal a sealed percentage.
Secondary-market sealed sales prove supply still exists but do not measure total supply.
Observed public breaks are a lower bound, not a representative sample of all openings.
Serial observations alone do not measure sealed product remaining.
A Live Odds adjustment requires a valid sealed-fraction range plus serial evidence.
At least two independent quantitative source types are required before Live Odds can become active.

current_estimate.note: Original Hobby production is now estimated as a range, but no defensible current sealed fraction exists yet.

next_quantitative_targets: repeatable marketplace sealed-listing census with deduplication
opening-volume dataset with known observation coverage
